name: app-liquid-glass-ribbon-floating-home-control-phones
title: Liquid Ribbon Around Home-Control Phones
whatItIs: A tall black poster with a large headline 'Home control that goes wherever you go' partly fading into a translucent black liquid ribbon looping around two floating phones (a dark camera feed and a cream device list).
whatItMeans: The liquid ribbon suggests flow and connection, and the fading headline blends type with imagery for a dramatic effect.
techniques: Headline that fades progressively along its second line
Glassy liquid 3D object encircling the devices
Two phones at opposing angles in a dark and a light UI
Pure black background so highlights glow

vocabulary.definition: Text whose lines lose opacity as they descend.
Two objects rotated in different directions for dynamism.
